LinkListResponse.description: Entire filtered collection; never paginated. At most 500 items and 8 MiB compact UTF-8. collectionRevision describes the global owned collection.

DashboardWidgetRequest.description: ID unique within the dashboard after trim; repeated types allowed. Optional settings must be omitted, never null. All sizes allowed for every type.

projectId.description: Optional, never null. Owned active or archived Project; save normalizes scope to all.

limit.description: Optional, never null. No default is inserted.

SaveHomeDashboardRequest.description: Atomic full replacement; all fields required. First save compares 0 and returns 1; stale first or later saves return 409. Same-value saves increment revision. No Idempotency-Key. Empty widgets allowed; IDs unique after trim.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration format version; unsupported integer versions return UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION.

projectId.description: Optional, never null. Owned active or archived Project; save normalizes scope to all.

limit.description: Optional, never null. No default is inserted.

HomeDashboardResponse.description: Configuration only, no business data. Unsaved GET returns deterministic defaults at revision 0 without creating state. Persisted revisions start at 1; saved empty widgets remain empty. Array order is layout order.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration format version; unsupported integer versions return UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION.

CreateTaskRequest.description: Only declared fields are writable. Explicit nulls and duplicates are invalid. Lengths use UTF-16 units. Optional text clears with an empty string.

CreateProjectRequest.description: Unknown fields are rejected. Explicit null is allowed only for categoryId. Omitted/null categoryId creates uncategorized; a UUID assigns an owned Category independently of scope. Omitted optional strings default to empty; progress defaults to zero. String limits use UTF-16 code units after applicable trimming.

currentMilestone.description: Goal memo, independent of milestone resources

repositoryUrl.description: Empty or absolute http/https URL with a host

CreateCategoryRequest.description: Name: Java trim then NFC; case-sensitive workspace uniqueness; at most 100 normalized UTF-16 units. Unknown/duplicate/null fields rejected.

CreateMilestoneRequest.description: Omitted dueDate defaults to null; omitted completed defaults to false. Explicit null is allowed only for dueDate. Unknown/duplicate fields and type coercion are rejected. Title length uses UTF-16 units.

dueDate.description: Calendar date in years 0001 through 9999; null clears the date

CreateLinkRequest.description: Only supplied fields change. Null, unknown and duplicate fields reject. URLs must have an http/https host and no credentials; strings use UTF-16 lengths.

CreateJournalRequest.description: Explicit nulls, duplicate and undeclared fields are invalid. Text limits use UTF-16 units. Body is preserved. entryDate is independent of audit timestamps.

entryDate.description: Calendar date, years 0001 through 9999; no time or timezone

UpdateTaskRequest.description: Only declared fields are writable. Explicit nulls and duplicates are invalid. Lengths use UTF-16 units. Optional text clears with an empty string.

UpdateProjectRequest.description: Only supplied fields change. categoryId omission preserves, null clears, UUID assigns an owned Category; archived Projects are editable. Other explicit nulls and unknown fields are rejected. Revision-only and same-value updates increment revision once.

RenameCategoryRequest.description: Both fields required. Same normalized name advances revision; revision-only PATCH is invalid. Name uses trim/NFC and case-sensitive workspace uniqueness.

UpdateMilestoneRequest.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged; revision is required. Explicit null is allowed only for dueDate. Unknown/duplicate fields and type coercion are rejected. Title length uses UTF-16 units.

dueDate.description: Calendar date in years 0001 through 9999; null clears the date

UpdateLinkRequest.description: Only supplied fields change. Null, unknown and duplicate fields reject. URLs must have an http/https host and no credentials; strings use UTF-16 lengths.

UpdateJournalRequest.description: Explicit nulls, duplicate and undeclared fields are invalid. Text limits use UTF-16 units. Body is preserved. entryDate is independent of audit timestamps.

entryDate.description: Calendar date, years 0001 through 9999; no time or timezone
